title: Lipid Lab — Lipids
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B lipids (Chapter 9) in six modes: Fatty Acid ID (saturation, shorthand, omega numbers, melting points, essential fatty acids from drawn chains), Build & Break (esterification, hydrolysis, saponification and hydrogenation of triacylglycerols), Lipid Line-up (classify triacylglycerols, phospholipids, sphingolipids, steroids, waxes and eicosanoids), Membranes & Transport (bilayers, diffusion, facilitated and active transport, surfactant), Lipids in the Clinic (lipoproteins, bile, fat-soluble vitamins, statins, NSAIDs), and Exam Practice (68 Final Boss lipid questions).
